test_cases.name: type_error_fix
test_cases.input: Traceback shows TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str'. Code does total = count + label.
assertions: Suggests converting label to int or using f-string

test_cases.name: key_error_handling
test_cases.input: KeyError: 'user_id' when accessing response['user_id'] from an API that sometimes omits the field.
assertions: Recommends .get() with default or explicit check

test_cases.name: file_not_found
test_cases.input: FileNotFoundError when opening 'config.yaml' that should exist relative to the script.
assertions: Checks whether parent directory creation is appropriate
